acceptance.given: A Toolchain implementation-plan allowed-change entry targets `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, or `.agents/skills/gds-*/**`.

oracle.expected: The plan validator classifies each protected-path target as forbidden and reports validation failure; the protected path is not admitted to the writable set.
forbidden: A successful validation that admits a target under `_bmad/**`.
A successful validation that admits a target under `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`.
A successful validation that admits a target under `.agents/skills/gds-*/**`.
Any modification to an installed BMAD or GDS Skill path.
oracle.observable: The unit selector observes `has_forbidden_allowed_path` returning true for representative paths in all three protected families and observes the validator reject an allowed-change entry in each family.

acceptance.then: The Toolchain plan validator rejects the proposed write scope and the installed BMAD/GDS paths remain write-protected.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain validator evaluates the proposed allowed-change paths.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Extend the existing forbidden-path unit selector with representative `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, and `.agents/skills/gds-*/**` paths; each must be classified forbidden, and a plan that places one in allowed changes must fail validation.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain plan write-scope validator reject every installed-skill protected family—`_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, and `.agents/skills/gds-*/**`—when encountered in allowed changes.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the validator's existing JSON report and exit-code contract; rollback only restores the prior protected-path predicate while leaving installed BMAD/GDS files unchanged.

slice_hint.state_transition: A proposed allowed-change path targeting an installed BMAD/GDS family transitions from candidate write scope to rejected plan validation; protected files remain unchanged.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The selected unit suite passes only when all three installed-skill path families are forbidden and no plan containing one of those paths can validate successfully.
